items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the travelogue 'Silk Road', and answer.

"The jeep lurched off the road and onto the snowfield. 'Shorter this way,' the driver grinned. For an hour we crawled across white emptiness, wheels spinning, engine coughing in the thin air. Twice we stuck fast and he dug us out with a shovel, still smiling. When we finally bumped back onto the track, I realised I had been holding my breath for most of the hour."

Why had the narrator been holding his breath?
items.answer: He was tense and afraid during the risky drive.
